title: I Built an AI Course That Writes AL Code With You — Here's What It Looks Like

chapters.title: Interactive lesson flow and Claude integration
First lesson walkthrough and environment setup

Starting the course, requirements, and conclusion

features.name: Learn AL with Claude course
features.description: An interactive course that teaches AL programming by having students write code alongside Claude AI in VS Code, with no videos or slides. Students learn concepts one by one through pair programming-like interaction.
caveats: Phase two covering rental bookings and maintenance tracking not yet part of the course

features.name: Claude AI pair programming assistant
features.description: Claude acts as an interactive tutor in the terminal, guiding students through lessons, asking for user input, and explaining concepts step by step. Described as having infinite patience for pair programming.

features.name: Lesson command framework
features.description: Each lesson has a markdown file with instructions for Claude on actions to take, such as reading company context, scenario documentation, and highlighting stakeholders. Lessons are launched with commands like slash start 1.1.

features.name: Company context and coding standards folder
features.description: A structured folder containing coding standards, extension requirements, and scenario documentation that students must follow. Includes object naming ranges, Pascal case conventions, file naming standards, and field grouping rules.

features.name: Equipment rental scenario for Nordic Outdoor Adventures
features.description: A realistic business scenario where students build a Business Central extension for a fictional outdoor equipment rental company with 12 locations across Scandinavia. The company uses BC for financials, purchasing, and sales but needs unified equipment tracking, rental processes, and maintenance scheduling.
caveats: Six weeks delivery timeframe for first version

features.name: Object creation with Claude file generation
features.description: Students can ask Claude to create AL object files such as enums and tables by having Claude generate the content as a cut command. This option can be toggled to speed up learning or to have students create files manually.
caveats: Can be configured to require manual file creation instead
Requires Claude with understanding of AL language

features.name: Interactive course with stopping points
features.description: Course structure includes stopping points where students are asked if content makes sense, and Claude can redo sections if clarification is needed. Creates a one-on-one tutoring experience with real-time interaction.

features.name: Lesson script framework
features.description: Course uses markdown files with structured lesson scripts containing teaching rules for AI, stop points, and interactive prompts to guide Claude through teaching specific AL concepts.

features.name: Course configuration in JSON
features.description: Course.json file defines modules, lessons, and course metadata with objects for course info, modules with IDs/names/descriptions, and scenario with company context, role, goal, and solution.

features.name: Reusable reference code library
features.description: Reference code folder acts as a cheat sheet for students, containing solutions for common tasks like creating enums and tables for quick reference if stuck.

features.name: Starter extension template
features.description: Blank canvas AL project template with launch.json and app.json files that students use as a starting point, with additional files created during the course.
